issues.description: tests/integration/test_iss503_rls_removal.zig's TC-ISS503-01/02/03 mutate the shared public.tenant table without transactional isolation between test blocks. Independently re-running test-integration-iss503 8 times produced 7 clean 4/4 passes and 1 failure of TC-ISS503-03 due to cross-test LEGACY_RLS fixture pollution under Zig's randomized test ordering. Matches the documented anti-pattern 'Shared mutable tenant or fixture state across integration test blocks'. Does not indicate a GBL-084 migration defect. Recommend a follow-up WF-03 to give these tests fully isolated fixtures.
